open.heading:
A beginning
{{of its own.}}
body: The early years here are not a smaller version of the senior school. They are given their own grounds and their own rooms — and the school’s published description of the stage says so in one line: *“the first years on campus, in rooms and grounds built for them.”*

That includes a prayer ground of their own. **Abhayeti** belongs to the junior block and is listed separately from Naman, the senior one, so the youngest children do not begin the day at the back of somebody else’s assembly.
All five are listed on the school’s own [facilities](/campus/facilities-infrastructure/) inventory.

doing.heading:
Little hands.
{{Big first experiences.}}
body: Almost everything the school lists for this stage is something a child does with their hands, their feet and the ground under them. The learning is physical long before it is written down.
**Photographs.** The school’s kids park, and its Little Agriculturists session. The sand pool and the water pool are published facilities it has not photographed.

land.heading:
They don’t just learn
{{about the world.}}
body: The school’s description of the Little Agriculture Land is one sentence long, and every verb in it belongs to the child: *“a planting plot the youngest children actually dig, sow and water.”* Not a display bed at the gate — a plot they work.

It runs as a named activity too. [Little Agriculturist](/beyond-academics/school-activities/little-agriculturists/) is published as a hands-on farming session for the youngest children, and the frames the school released from it show composting — kitchen peel and dry leaf going into the bin, gloves on, and the finished compost coming back out in a tray.

abh.heading:
A space
to {{begin together.}}
body: The junior block has a prayer ground of its own, and the school gives it a name: **Abhayeti**. It appears on the facilities list beside Naman, the senior block’s ground, as a separate entry — which is the whole point of it.
A four-year-old’s first assembly is not held at the edge of a field built for eighteen-year-olds. It is held on ground that belongs to their half of the school.
The school publishes the name and whose ground it is. It does not publish what happens there, and it has released no photograph of Abhayeti itself.

first.heading:
Three years,
counted as {{one stage.}}
body: The school publishes Nursery, LKG and UKG as one stage on its [academic structure](/academics/structure/). Admission ages, session hours and class sizes are not published, and are not estimated here.
“School as a place you want to be.”
firstBand.caption: And one milestone

cellsTwo.value: The syllabus is published class by class **from Nursery**, as the school’s PRECEPT document.
The SOF olympiad is sat **from Nursery to Class II** — the first time the work is measured from outside.

close.kicker: The end of the early years
close.heading:
Three years,
and then {{the gown.}}
body: The school holds a convocation for KG-II — a gown, a mortar board and a rolled scroll handed over on stage. It marks the last day of the early years the way a university marks its last, and it is the clearest statement the school makes about how seriously it takes this stage.
Photograph: the KG-II convocation ceremony at {schoolName}.
